description: This file is a React component for a Next.js front-end application, implementing a user interface for uploading documents, generating, viewing, and managing a persona. It handles file uploads, orchestrates API calls for persona creation and finalization, manages application state across different steps, and provides UI for editing and viewing persona details.

methods.name: handleFileChange
methods.description: Handles user-selected files for upload, performs validation, updates state with new files, and manages upload limits and errors.

methods.name: handleDrop
methods.description: Handles drag-and-drop of files into upload area, adds dropped files to upload queue.

methods.name: removeFile
methods.description: Removes a selected uploaded file from the upload list.

methods.name: handleGenerateDraft
methods.description: Triggers the process of uploading documents, initiating persona draft generation via API, handling orchestration, and updating application state accordingly.

methods.name: handleSaveChanges
methods.description: Saves the current persona data to backend, locking in edits.

methods.name: handleFinalize
methods.description: Finalizes the persona, persisting it as the official version for downstream systems.

methods.name: handleRegenerateDraft
methods.description: Re-initiates draft persona generation for current build.

methods.name: getFileType
methods.description: Returns a string representing the file extension/type for display.

methods.name: extractPersonaJsonFromOrchestrationRecord
methods.description: Extracts persona JSON object and source path from orchestration record, attempting to find the most relevant data.

methods.name: coercePersonaDataFromBackendJson
methods.description: Converts backend persona JSON into UI's persona data structure, mapping fields and enriching data.

methods.name: fingerprintPersonaData
methods.description: Creates a hash string representing persona data, used for change detection.

methods.name: fingerprintPersonaArtifact
methods.description: Creates a fingerprint for the persona JSON artifact, used to detect changes.
